stable.title: DroidDeck 0.6.9
stable.summary: DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No source withheld.

preview.title: fix: keep the bottom-screen menu and layout editor open when the screen turns off
preview.summary: Turning the screen off closed everything open in a session: the DroidDeck menu, the input settings page and the layout editor. On a dual screen handheld that meant a layout being edited on the bottom screen vanished on every sleep, and the bottom screen came back showing the default Dashboard panel.

recentPreviews.title: fix: keep the bottom-screen menu and layout editor open when the screen turns off
recentPreviews.summary: Turning the screen off closed everything open in a session: the DroidDeck menu, the input settings page and the layout editor. On a dual screen handheld that meant a layout being edited on the bottom screen vanished on every sleep, and the bottom screen came back showing the default Dashboard panel.

recentPreviews.title: fix(storage): a Second library on a raw /mnt/mediarw path is used again
recentPreviews.summary: A Second library saved as a raw volume path (/mnt/mediarw/<volume>/...) is treated as unplugged on Preview, so sessions run with internal storage only and none of that library's games show up. Stable is fine. Reported on a Samsung S25 with /mnt/mediarw/B2BD-BCFC/STEAM GAMES; their Preview log has game storage: internal only, their Stable log mounts the folder at /mnt/droiddeck-sd.

recentPreviews.title: feat: let users turn off the low-storage warning
recentPreviews.summary: Pressing Play Steam with under 10 GB free shows the "Only X GB free" dialog every time. This adds a "Warn when storage is low" toggle in the launcher Settings, next to Animations, and a "Don't warn me about this again" switch on the dialog itself. Both flip the same setting. When it is off, Steam starts straight away with no dialog.

recentPreviews.title: test: skip the unscrubbable session log test when file permissions are not enforced
recentPreviews.summary: SessionLogShareTest.aFileThatCouldNotBeScrubbedLeavesTheFolderUnrecorded depends on a denied write. Root ignores file mode bits, so the test fails on the root self-hosted runner (droiddeck-desktop), as seen in run 42421920730: 3800 tests, 1 failed. #2237 guarded six tests like this one; this is the remaining one.

recentPreviews.title: test: skip permission-denial tests when running as root
recentPreviews.summary: The new self-hosted runners run the unit tests as root, which ignores file mode bits, so six tests that depend on a denied read or write fail there while passing on GitHub-hosted runners (seen on #2236):

recentPreviews.title: fix(input): restore the controls, panels and settings #1439 removed
recentPreviews.summary: Restores the on-screen controls, second-screen panels and settings that #1439 ("Unify controller and screen input profiles", 22a675a66) removed or broke. Each item was checked against the code before #1439 (22a675a66^) and put back to match it. The fixes go through the unified input profiles instead of reviving the old views.

recentPreviews.title: ci: run compile jobs on the org workstation runner when it is idle
recentPreviews.summary: The two heavy x86 jobs (components, build) now run on the org's self-hosted workstation runner (droiddeck-ws, 24 cores) when it is online and idle, and on ubuntu-24.04 otherwise.

recentPreviews.title: fix(input): controller navigation works across the Controller tab and profile menus
recentPreviews.summary: The unified input pages from #1439 used plain touch-only rows, cards and text buttons, so a controller could not activate them, saw no focus highlight, and lost focus whenever a page swapped.

recentPreviews.title: fix: uninstalling a Flatpak app that Flatpak no longer has removes its folder
recentPreviews.summary: If Flatpak no longer has an app's ref but its folder under app/<id> is still there (for example after an interrupted uninstall), the app stays in the launcher. Uninstalling it reports "not installed" and changes nothing, so the app is stuck.

recentPreviews.title: fix(proton-run): follow a removed DroidDeck-Proton build to the newest one
recentPreviews.summary: Since the Preview builds of 11-07, World of Warcraft started from Battle.net in DroidDeck often never comes up. Battle.net closes (that part is by design), and then the game hangs on the DroidDeck logo. The same install works through Steam. It was reported on Discord by several users with components on Auto, across a OnePlus 13, an AYN Thor, a Retroid Pocket 6 and an Odin 3 Max.

tests.title: fix(gamescope): direct-touch drags work again in games that confine a hidden cursor
tests.summary: In Direct touch, dragging stopped working in games that draw their own cursor (Balatro, Stardew Valley). A drag moves the pointer but never holds a button down; taps still click.

tests.title: fix(library): added and Battle.net games sort by when they were played and installed
tests.summary: Sorting the Library by Recently played or Recently installed puts World of Warcraft, and every other added game, at the bottom of All, whatever was played or installed last (reported on Discord). Title and size sorting work.

tests.title: fix(storage): Clean up keeps Proton EasyAntiCheat and BattlEye runtimes
tests.summary: Clean up listed \"Proton EasyAntiCheat Runtime\" and \"Proton BattlEye Runtime\" as unused x86 Protons because their install folders start with \Proton \. Steam fetches these runtimes for any game that ships anti-cheat files, even when the launch option skips anti-cheat (e.g. Halo MCC). With the runtime removed, the game's install and launch stall at \"Downloading Content 0%\": Steam reuses the

tests.title: fix(drivers): leaving a driver bundle's display half also drops its runtime half
tests.summary: Picking either half of an Android + Linux driver bundle selects both drivers. Picking another display driver afterwards (for example "Auto - picked by GPU" to go back to DroidDeck's drivers) changed only the display, so every later session still loaded the bundle's Linux driver. If that Linux half doesn't work, sessions keep failing after the user has "switched back", and Components shows nothing

tests.title: fix(steam): restore the client branch file when the desktop client deletes it
tests.summary: After opening the Steam client in Desktop mode, Steam offers the same client update on every start. Installing it does not help: after the restart it offers it again.

tests.title: ci: run approved fork PR compile jobs on the disposable fork runner
tests.summary: Approved fork PRs can now compile on a self-hosted runner instead of always using GitHub-hosted runners.

tests.title: fix: refresh the session loading tips
tests.summary: Rewrites the tips shown while a Steam or desktop session loads. The old ones said the controller defaults to an Xbox 360 pad and that leaving the app pauses by default, neither of which is true now. New tips cover the controller types, held Back for Quick Access, background behavior modes, frame limit, low latency, game profiles, mic and suspend, HUD docking, dual-screen bottom screen and swap, ex

tests.title: feat: Trinkets tab with a Bluetooth controller mode
tests.summary: Adds a Trinkets tab to the rail. Its first entry turns the device into a Bluetooth gamepad for another PC, phone or handheld.

tests.title: feat: a per-game relative mouse switch for games that confine and warp the cursor
tests.summary: Some games read the mouse by confining it and warping it back, so in a Steam session the pointer stops at the screen edge and aim is capped by screen size.

tests.title: feat: Performance boost switch for any phone, with Samsung clock floors and a boost report
tests.summary: A Boost group in Settings → Performance: a switch that asks the phone for more speed while a game falls behind, a log of what it did, and a test mode that measures whether it helps. This PR is mainly for testers: no frame-rate gain has been measured yet.

tests.title: Proton: QueryPerformanceCounter reads the CPU timer on ARM64EC
tests.summary: Windows on ARM answers QueryPerformanceCounter from the CPU's generic timer without leaving user space. Wine's ARM64EC ntdll makes a system call for every one: through FEX's syscall callback and Wine's dispatcher into clockgettime. DroidDeck-Proton's own user-mode TSC patch excludes ARM64EC, so phones still pay for every read.

tests.title: test: frame-order glitch on Adreno 740: order and producer-fence logging, draw on the tick
tests.summary: Diagnostic build, not for merge.

tests.title: feat(input): add native PS5 DualSense & DualSense Edge wireless/wired support
fix: a recreated launcher screen keeps running installs and save work busy
tests.summary: After the launcher screen is recreated (a language change, a settings reset, or a configuration change it doesn't handle), work that is still running stays marked busy. It is no longer possible to start a session or remove the Linux runtime while that work is writing into it.

tests.title: fix: a failing agent environment no longer blocks session start
tests.summary: Sessions now start even if the agent environment state can't be read or written.

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself; a crawling source is dropped for a faster one
tests.summary: Main already falls back from a client-update host that does not answer. It still starts with whichever one answers the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest. The install now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used. The x86-64 client's own install does th

tests.title: feat: add maintenance for other game stores
tests.summary: Installed games outside GOG lacked a consistent maintenance workflow. This adds metadata-only update checks and a compact Maintenance menu, pins queued targets to their existing installation folder, and preserves installation settings through maintenance and recovery.

tests.title: fix: keep 6+2 Oryon cores, Fold SoC names, and 120 Hz display mode across fold changes
tests.summary: Keep all 8 cores in programcores() on 6+2 Oryon SoCs (SM8750-AC / SM8850-AC), strip Samsung -AC/-AB SoC model suffixes in SocNames (alongside the canoe / Adreno 840 platform entries and a hex gpuchipid guard), and pin preferredDisplayModeId across fold/unfold configuration changes in PerfMode and SessionActivity.

tests.title: fix: duplicate cursors and clicks that miss in a game session
tests.summary: Problem. Input in a game session went wrong in several ways:

tests.title: fix: the virtual pads reach non-Steam programs, where udev is resolved through dlsym
tests.summary: Outside Steam the pads were invisible: Firefox and Chromium load libudev with dlopen and look the symbols up with dlsym, which skips interposition, so the browser found no pad even though the virtual device was there. SDL2 (SDLudev.c) and hidapi's Linux backend take the same route, so any program outside Steam that enumerates udev input devices missed them too.

tests.title: feat(input): make the controls toggle and keyboard buttons movable in the layout editor
tests.summary: The controls toggle and the keyboard button were drawn at fixed offsets from the screen corner, so the layout editor could not show or move them: they were not part of the control list, and their positions came from hardcoded insets.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: itch.io: install Linux builds and start them through Steam
tests.summary: Follow-up to #1503. Linux builds in the itch.io version picker, which were listed as "Not supported yet", can now be installed and started through Steam like every other game.

tests.title: Experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for the Linux runtime
tests.summary: This adds an experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for DroidDeck's Linux runtime. Steam, Proton and Linux apps can run on the phone's own Adreno Vulkan driver (or an imported AdrenoTools driver) instead of Turnip. Proton games, the Steam client and Zink-based OpenGL all present through it. The phone's system graphics stack is not modified and nothing needs root.

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
